decision_overrides.evidence: HV01: 7 of 24 samples across four Gemma 4 E4B builds; the non-QAT Q4_K_M and UD files chose PerCampaign in all 12 samples, with and without the card.

notes: UNTESTED HYPOTHESIS PRESET: starting points for tuning (doc 55 section 4; D048 item 4). No value here has been run with this preset; status stays 'draft' until tuning, and becomes 'tuned' only after the sealed held-out rules PR1-PR7 pass.
Draft: every change is a hypothesis for doc 55 section 4.

gbnf_compact: under llama-server's json_schema grammar Gemma pretty-prints JSON, 16.3 output tokens per pick against 7 for Qwen and for the same model on Ollama, about 200 ms per pick on the reference card (doc 46 section 2.6). Adopt only if accuracy is non-inferior.

explanation_plus_code_fix: the QAT build proposed the same invented one-line syntax as the fix for finding E10 on both runtimes (doc 46 section 2.5); the model keeps the explanation, the fix comes from code's fix list or the card.
The vendor's sampler (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64 'across all use cases') is a tuning arm for text only; Pick and Fill keep the measured 0.6.

Not recommendable while the GGUF says 'gemma' and the card says Apache-2.0 (D023 amendment, D037); the preset still serves a custom install and must be re-bound if Google's official QAT Q4_0 file becomes the default.
